description: Generate a fix prompt for a weekly finding or a Search Console opportunity. Prepare a coding-agent prompt from an owned report within the free allowance or active plan. Read prompt_allowance first. A check uses one unit; full uses three. Preserve request_id for retries.

check_id.description: Weekly finding type, or opportunity for Search Console. Required for check; absent for full.

language.description: Language of the prompt instructions and check names: en for English, pt for Portuguese.

query.description: Exact opportunity query; required for Search Console check.

report_id.description: Required for weekly: saved report ID.

request_id.description: New UUID v4 per generation. Keep it unchanged for retries.

source.description: weekly: a finding of a saved weekly report. search_console: a saved Search Console opportunity.

name: generate_site_fix_prompt
title: Generate site fix prompt
